decisions.reason: As a track-system accessory that builds directly on the firm's established offer and was launched visibly on the home page, it fits the existing portfolio well and escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to withdraw it absent clear evidence of lasting failure.

Although this LED luminaire appears to have received less visible commitment than some other launches, it is still close to the core lighting business in a growing market, so management is more likely to retain it than to concede a mistaken launch.

The home automation server box supports the firm's stated direction toward controllable premium home lighting, implying higher strategic importance and sunk development effort that would, under escalation of commitment, strongly favor keeping it.

A luminaire family presented on its own page suggests a broader and more public commitment, and because it is tightly linked to the firm's core premium lighting range, management would likely continue it unless poor results had become unmistakable.
